faq.title: Questions from procurement and quality teams
faq.q1: Which ISO certificates do you hold?
faq.a1: We hold ISO 9001:2015 for quality management, ISO 14001:2015 for environmental management and ISO 45001:2018 for occupational health and safety.
faq.q2: How do you check that an order matches our specification?
faq.a2: We agree the species, weight grade, packing and labels with you before the order. The fish are washed, iced, graded by weight and packed whole on ice, then checked against the agreed specification before the boxes are closed.
faq.q3: How do you keep the fish cold until shipment?
faq.a3: The fish are washed, iced and packed whole on ice. We run our own cold stores and refrigerated trucks, then ship by air or road freight. We confirm the temperature requirements for your product when we agree the order.
faq.q4: Can you meet our market's labelling or import requirements?
faq.a4: Requirements differ by country. Tell us yours, and we review them for each product and market before we confirm supply.
faq.q5: What traceability information comes with an order?
faq.a5: Tell us what your market or customer requires. We confirm which lot and shipment details we can provide before you order.
faq.a6: For fast deals, message our management directly on WhatsApp at <wa>+20 100 773 6419</wa>. For details and documents, email our export team at <mail>business@azafco.com.eg</mail>.

closing.title: Share your specification
closing.text: Tell us the species, weight grade, packing and destination, and any requirements of your market. Our export team will review supply and commercial terms. Sending your requirements does not commit you to an order.
